'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Peter Huderich LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Huderich]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).

Handwritten Xerox form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' peterich
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
